layers.message: Scope and design configurable delivery retries
Add configurable retry limit and dead-letter file
Record implementation review for delivery retries

graderOnly: The unstaged docs/operations.md correction is accurate: it documents RETRY_LIMIT (default 5) and DEAD_LETTER_PATH (default data/dead-letter.jsonl), six attempts by default with waits of 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 seconds capped at 30 seconds, the dead-letter line fields, and a --print-config example whose output matches bin/relay.js exactly.

Every identity recorded in the documentation record still matches current content: the source and test files are unchanged since the commit it names, and the guide blob it names is the current working-tree guide.
All required documentation surfaces (docs/operations.md and README.md) are assessed, and no Documenter-owned blocker, open discrepancy, or outstanding obligation remains.

No final-deliverable review or synchronization record exists for this cycle and that work never started, so no rerun is needed before ResumeAt; the correct route pops Frame 1 and records a RESUME to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, keeping CompletionPolicy IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED.

Implementation review finding F-001 and its INELIGIBLE closure assessment remain Reviewer's to reassess; Documenter must not resolve that finding, edit the review report, or claim closure eligibility.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 50-project (pre-install): small Node relay service whose retry loop retries three times and drops failed deliveries; docs/operations.md documents that. 55-design: CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001 RETRY_LIMIT, AC-002 operations guide, AC-003 dead-letter file), design (AC-002 no architectural impact), STATE at DEVELOPING with CompletionPolicy IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED recorded in the Request. 60-implementation: new config/deliver/deadLetter/relay code, updated tests, COMPLETE AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION plan, STATE at TESTING. 65-verification: COMPLETE FULL verification report (AC-002 pending Documenter), STATE at REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. 70-review: BLOCKED implementation review with F-001 (guide still describes old behavior, owner Documenter, DOCUMENTATION) and an INELIGIBLE Implementation-Reviewed Closure section; STATE at DOCUMENTING with Handoff FAILURE from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION and Frame 1 (From/ResumeAt REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, Owner DOCUMENTING, RerunThrough NONE). 75-guide: unstaged corrected docs/operations.md. 80-record: untracked IN_PROGRESS documentation record from an earlier Documenter session with inputs, checks, resolved DOC-001, and the gate conclusion and handoff not yet recorded.
